Thank you all — this has been a thorough and productive round-robin. Let me summarize what I've heard before I make my decision. Evan has flagged a hard scheduling constraint: no availability after 4pm due to caregiving responsibilities, with Tuesday at 10am as the preferred slot. Rina has surfaced a serious past working experience — two heated exchanges between the group leads over event ownership — and recommends an independent facilitator for the first six shared meetings. Dev has flagged a forthcoming Employee Relations process requirement: anonymous feedback must be collected from both groups' members before any new charter is adopted, though the guidance is still in draft. And Clara, as executive sponsor, has put on record a prior commitment that each network retains one independently chosen program per quarter even under the shared structure.

Before I settle on the governance structure and operating commitments, I want to make sure I'm not missing anything. Does anyone have additional practical constraints, past working experiences, or process requirements they haven't yet shared? If not, I'm prepared to move forward with my approval decision.
